court: High Court of Judicature at Bombay
case_name: Pankaj S/O Nanaji Choudhary And 7 Others vs State Of Mah. Thr. Pso S Wathoda Nagpur

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Pankaj S/o Nanaji Choudhary (Husband), Nanaji S/o Namahun Choudhary (Father-in-law), Shantabai W/o Nanaji Choudhary, Rajesh @ Rajendra S/o Nanaji Choudhary, Mukesh S/o Ishwari Pardhi, Sonu W/o Mukesh Pardhi, Ravindra S/o Somaji Gautam
parties.respondent_defendant: State of Maharashtra, through Police Station Officer, Police Station, Wathoda, Nagpur

facts_of_case: The applicants are challenging the registration of a first information report filed against them by applicant no.8 with non-applicant - Police Station, Wathoda, Nagpur for the offence punishable under Sections 498-A, 294, 323 and 506 of the Indian Penal Code.

legal_principles.principle: The court cannot decline to quash a criminal case if the first information report does not disclose the ingredients of the offence.
legal_principles.held: The Court shall make all endeavour whether the first information report indeed discloses the ingredient of such offence and Court can accept the settlement and quash the proceedings.
cited_cases: Narinder Singh vs. State of Punjab, (2014) AIR SCW 2065

legal_principles.principle: The court can accept a settlement and quash criminal proceedings if the parties have amicably resolved their dispute.
legal_principles.held: We are satisfied that the ingredients of the offence alleged against the applicants are not satisfied even if the allegations are accepted and the material produced in the charge-sheet is taken on its face value.

outcome.final_order: Rule is made returnable forthwith. Heard finally by consent of the parties.
